pluginText.pf.edges: {"weather":"Rain, strong wind or freezing cold on install day: the crew doesn't open a wall; the day moves, with no fee","factory_late":"A factory order is late: the install day moves and the owner is told the new day, with no fee; or an in-stock item with the owner's yes","wrong_size":"A window that doesn't fit because of the business's own measure is remade at the business's cost; a size the owner changes after the order is a change order","glass_broken":"Glass broken in delivery or on site: remade, a new day, no fee to the customer","hidden_conditions":"Rot behind the trim, an out-of-square opening or a weak lintel found when the old window comes out: a change order before the fix","lead_or_asbestos":"Lead paint, or old putty that may hold asbestos: lead-safe or licensed work first, by its own quote; the start moves","made_to_order":"Made-to-order glass and frames can't be returned once in production; the contract says so, and the cancel window comes first","permit_late":"The install moves with no fee; Alex is told","inspection_fails":"The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the last bill waits","cancel_after_window":"Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own","nobody_home":"Estimates and tune-ups with the gate open, with start and end photos","over_license_limit":"Not offered, and the owner is told why","walk_through_dispute":"Goes to Sam; the last bill waits","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
